::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 247,774 people lived in County Kildare, up 11.4% on 2016. It had the 4th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 2.2 times its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Kildare was €1,701, the third highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Kildare

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Kildare was €30,612, the 6th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Kildare was €445,700, the third highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 8.8 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Kildare, the 5th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 24% of households in County Kildare rented their home, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 19% of people living in County Kildare were born outside Ireland, the 9th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 42% of people aged 3 and over in County Kildare said they could speak Irish, the 9th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 39% of people at work in County Kildare worked from home for at least part of the week, the third highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 74% of people travelling to work in County Kildare went by car, the 23rd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Kildare live more than 1.3 km by road from a GP, the 23rd furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Kildare live more than 15.5 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 19th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 5.7% of County Kildare in 2021, the 22nd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
